bio: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at PES University, currently pursuing my Bachelor's degree with a focus on Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. With hands-on experience in various projects ranging from AI-powered sports commentary to detecting LLM-generated text, I have developed expertise in Python, C++, NLP, and cloud technologies like AWS and Docker. I'm passionate about using data-driven insights to solve real-world challenges and am actively seeking full-time job opportunities in data science or machine learning roles. Let's connect and explore how I can contribute to your team!
